description: Use this when the user wants a live scoreboard: "keep score for me and Anna", "scoreboard for game night with 4 players", "add 12 points to Anna". Pass mode highest (default), lowest, or target with a positive target score. Scores stay in the open widget only; no online multiplayer. Shows a widget with one row per player, +N/-N buttons (use Smaller step and Bigger step to change the step), undo and history for the last 20 score changes with round numbers, and running totals. Pass the initial player names (2-12); totals start at 0 unless you pass initial scores. Do not use it to score dice sheets or darts legs — use score_dice_sheet or score_darts_leg for those.

mode.description: Win mode, e.g. lowest for a penalty game, highest (default), or target for first to a target score.

players.description: Player names in seating order, e.g. ["Anna", "Ben"]. 2-12 players.

scores.description: Optional starting totals, same order and length as players. Default 0, e.g. [25,0].

target.description: Required target for target mode, e.g. 100. Ignored for highest/lowest modes.

name: show_scoreboard
title: Show scoreboard
